items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: He made the record with us, the first records we ever made.

ctx.x: Don't call me New York. I'm a cracker. Where was Ben Borders home? Do you know? Oh, Ben.
Yeah. Well, what's Ben? Ben. I think Ben Borders was somewhere down in Texas. Yeah.
In Texas. You don't know what Borders is?

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Who was on drums? Ben Borders.

ctx.x: Society. Yeah, yeah. Our society and uh... Oh, I forgot.
We had Dick Johnson on clarinet. He played clarinet on that. Fred Weiss played piano. Who was on drums? Ben Borders. Ben Borders.
He died, didn't he? Yes. Yes.
